intro.h2: Kitchen and bath remodeling in Warwick, built on 37 years of Rhode Island homes
paragraphs: RIKB Design Build has handled kitchen and bath remodeling in Warwick since it opened its doors in 1989. The family-owned firm plans, designs and installs every project itself, which gives it tighter control over scheduling, quality and cost than a contractor who hands off parts of the job.

Before you commit, you can stand inside full-size kitchen and bath displays at 139 Jefferson Boulevard. Open the drawers, feel the countertop finishes, compare tile and fixtures. Several RIKB design consultants are Certified Kitchen & Bath designers and Certified Aging in Place Specialists, so a bath can be planned for the years ahead, not just for today.

services.h2: Rooms the RIKB team plans and builds

items.name: Kitchens
items.blurb: Simple cosmetic updates, pull-and-replace kitchens or a fully custom room, in traditional, contemporary or modern styles. Designers work on the layout, storage and countertop choice first, because those small decisions often make the biggest daily difference.

image.alt: Burrillville, RI kitchen remodel with white shaker cabinets, a stained wood island with white top, dark ceiling beams and glass globe pendants

items.name: Bathrooms
items.blurb: Primary baths, guest baths and closets turned into powder rooms. The designers ask questions you may not have thought of, then help you choose materials that fit your budget, from a simple cosmetic refresh to a spa-like retreat.

image.alt: Providence, RI bathroom with a white freestanding tub, brass tub filler, green tile shower behind black steel-framed glass and dark slate floor

items.name: Aging in Place
items.blurb: Certified Aging in Place Specialists plan baths and kitchens that work as your needs change, such as zero-entry showers and fold-down shower seats. RIKB has also won a Qualified Remodeler Master Design Bronze award for an accessible bathroom.

image.alt: Bristol, RI primary bathroom with a zero-entry shower, navy wall tile, a fold-down teak shower seat and basketweave mosaic floor

items.name: Additions, Basements and Whole Homes
items.blurb: Home additions, finished basements, multi-room renovations, game rooms and bar areas. RIKB won a Chrysalis regional award for an addition under $250k and a PRO New England Gold award for an entire house, so larger projects are routine here.

image.alt: Rhode Island living room remodel with a white fireplace surround, coffered ceiling and a wall of windows facing the water

items.name: Mudrooms, Pantries and Built-ins
items.blurb: The smaller rooms that make a house run: mudrooms, laundry rooms, pantries, home offices, built-ins and coffee bars. Each one gets the same design consultant, 3D planning and installation crew as a full kitchen remodel would.

image.alt: North Kingstown, RI coffee bar with a white glass-front cabinet, gold faucet, scrolled tile panel and white subway backsplash

about.h2: A family-owned team led by Tanya Donahue
about.text: Tanya Donahue is Owner and President of RIKB Design Build, the family-owned company that started in Warwick in 1989 as Rhode Island Kitchen & Bath. From the start, the firm has hired people with a passion for remodeling and kept training them. Design consultants earn CKD and CAPS credentials, and the company is EPA LeadSafe certified. Homeowners remember the people by name: designers Kelly May, Erika and Stephanie, and project manager Jamie all come up in reviews. RIKB also donates used building materials and supports the Rhode Island Community Food Bank, collecting food at its seminars.

image.alt: Tanya Donahue, Owner and President of RIKB Design Build in Warwick, RI

steps.title: Imagine
steps.text: The team starts with questions about how you live, then visits your home to measure and talk through ideas with your budget in mind.

steps.title: Conceptualize
steps.text: At the design center you see concepts in 3D modeling software. A Project Development Agreement sets the chosen concept and budget.

steps.title: Collaborate
steps.text: Your designer turns the concept into detailed plans and walks you through cabinetry, countertops, plumbing fixtures, flooring and lighting until construction documents are final.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Materials are received and inspected at RIKB's facility, you meet the installation crew, and trained craftspeople complete the work in your home.

service_area.h2: Remodeling across Rhode Island and just over the line
service_area.text: The design center sits on Jefferson Boulevard in Warwick, and the crews work throughout Rhode Island, southeastern Massachusetts and eastern Connecticut. Recent project photos come from Providence's East Side, East Greenwich, Bristol, Barrington, Warren, Portsmouth, Newport, Tiverton, Narragansett, North Kingstown, Glocester and Burrillville. Over the years the team has remodeled many historic and coastal homes, keeping character details and choosing durable materials.

faq.h2: Common questions for the RIKB design team

items.q: Do you work outside Rhode Island?
items.a: Yes. RIKB serves homeowners throughout Rhode Island, southeastern Massachusetts and eastern Connecticut from the Warwick design center. It is licensed in all three states: Rhode Island Reg. #3984, Massachusetts #164199 and Connecticut HIC.0673137. Call to confirm your town falls inside the service area.

items.q: How long will my remodel take?
items.a: It depends on size and scope. Smaller projects may take just a few weeks, and larger renovations or additions take longer. Because design and product selections are final before work begins, delays stay low. One client wrote that a complete kitchen was finished in the promised three and a half weeks.

Every project is guaranteed for five full years under RIKB's Quality Assurance and Five-Year Workmanship Warranty. That is on top of manufacturer warranties on many installed products. RIKB also carries liability insurance up to $2 million per project and workers' compensation for every staff member.

items.q: Can you remodel an older or coastal home?
items.a: Yes. The team has remodeled many historic and character-filled homes, keeping the architectural details while updating how the rooms work. It has also finished projects in coastal communities, where it chooses durable materials and plans layouts around natural light and water views.

items.q: Can I visit the design center first?
items.a: Please do. The 3,000+ square foot design center at 139 Jefferson Boulevard is open weekdays 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. and Saturdays 10 a.m. to 2 p.m., with off-hours appointments on request. RIKB also hosts complimentary remodeling seminars there, and you can book a virtual consultation.

final_cta.h2: Walk the Warwick design center, then plan your remodel
final_cta.text: Call to book a consultation, in person on Jefferson Boulevard or virtually with a design consultant.
